Bulbasaur.description: Bulbasaur is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon. Bulbasaur is a small, mainly turquoise amphibian Pokémon with red eyes and a green bulb on its back. The bulb grows into a flower as it evolves. It is one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon in Kanto region.

Ivysaur.description: Ivysaur is an evolved form of Bulbasaur. Ivysaur is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon. The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

Venusaur.description: Venusaur is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon and an evolved form of Ivysaur. The plant bulb that was on the back of its previous evolutions, Bulbasaur and Ivysaur, has now bloomed into a large flower with large pink petals and a yellow center. The female has a seed in the center.

Charmander.description: Charmander is a Fire type Pokémon. Charmander is a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. Most of its body is colored orange, while its underbelly is light yellow and it has blue eyes. It has a flame at the end of its tail, which is said to signify its health. It is one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon in Kanto region.

Charmeleon.description: Charméleon is an evolved form of Charmander. Charméleon is a Fire type Pokémon. When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Charizard.description: Charizard is a Fire/Flying type Pokémon and an evolved form of Charméleon. Charizard is a large dragon-like Pokémon, mainly orange in color. It has two large wings, the underside of which are turquoise.

Squirtle.description: Squirtle is a Water type Pokémon of Generation 1. Squirtle is a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. It has a blue body with purple eyes, a light brown belly, and a tough red-brown shell on its back. It has a long tail that curls into a spiral. Squirtle is notable for being one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon.

Wartortle.description: Wartortle is a Water type Pokémon and an evolved form of Squirtle.

Blastoise.description: Blastoise is an evolved form of Wartortle. It has a blue body with small purple eyes, a light brown belly, and a stubby tail. It has a large brown shell with two powerful water cannons on either side, which can be withdrawn.

Caterpie.description: Caterpie is a Bug type Pokémon. Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

Metapod.description: Metapod is a Bug type Pokémon and an evolved form of Caterpee. It hardens its shell to protect itself.

Butterfree.description: Butterfree is a Bug/Flying type Pokémon and an evolved form of Metapod. In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air

Vulpix.description: Vulpix is a Fire type Pokémon. At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

Vulpix (Alolan).description: Vulpix has an Alolan Form. It is ice type pokemon. It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

Ninetales.description: Ninetales is a Fire type Pokémon and an evolved form of Vulpix. It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

Ninetales (Alolan).description: Ninetales has an Alolan Form and is an ice/fairy type pokemon. It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

Oddish.description: Oddish is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon. During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

Gloom.description: Gloom is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon and an evolved form of Oddish. The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

Vileplume.description: Vileplume is a Grass/Poison type Pokémon an evolved form of Gloom. The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

Paras.description: Paras is a Bug/Grass type Pokémon. It under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

Parasect.description: Parasect is a Bug/Grass type Pokémon. The bug host is drained of energy by the mushrooms on its back. They appear to do all the thinking.

Venonat.description: Venonat is a Bug/Poison type Pokémon. Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night. Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

Venomoth.description: Venomoth is a Bug/Poison type Pokémon and an evolved form of Venonat. The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

Diglett.description: Diglett is a Ground type Pokémon. It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.

Diglett (Alolan).description: Diglett has an Alolan Form. Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

Dugtrio.description: Dugtrio is a Ground type Pokémon and an evolved form of Diglett. A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it’s an earthquake.

Dugtrio (Alolan).description: Dugtrio has an Alolan Form. Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

Meowth.description: Meowth is a Normal type Pokémon from Kanto region. It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep

Persian.description: Persian is a Normal type Pokémon introduced in Kanto region. The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

Meowth (Alolan).description: Meowth has an Alolan Form. This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty. When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

Persian (Alolan).description: Persian has an Alolan Form. It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

Meowth (Galarian).description: Meowth has a Galarian Form. These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth. Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon’s body so much that parts of it have turned to iron

Psyduck.description: Psyduck is a Water type Pokémon introduced in Kanto. It is always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.

Golduck.description: Golduck is a Water type Pokémon introduced in Kanto. Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.

Bellossom.description: Bellossom is a Grass type Pokémon and an evolved form of Gloom. BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

Perrserker.description: Perrserker is a Steel type Pokémon introduced in Galar. What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle. After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
